name: kittens-saved
description: Counts the kittens you save by doing the work instead of punting it, and gates the agent's escape hatch: you may only stop cleanly when nothing of yours is left unsaved. A Stop-hook reminder, a JSONL ledger, and a statusline segment.

scope.title: Tally scope
scope.description: Whether the statusline and the default `/kittens-saved:count` show kittens saved in this session only, or across all sessions. One of: session, all.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to false to silence the Stop-hook reminder and the statusline segment everywhere. Per-session control is /kittens-saved:toggle off.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: When true, the hooks echo the content they inject to stderr, prefixed [kittens-saved-debug], so you can see the reminder in the transcript / claude --debug without decoding the hook JSON.
